entities.name: Mickaël Gelabale
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mickaël Gelabale is a French former professional basketball player who last played for Élan Chalon of the Pro B. He also represents the France national basketball team internationally. Standing at 2.01 m, he plays either at the small forward position or the power forward position in a small ball configuration.
